description: Retrieval evaluation questions for the Harris County floodplain permit corpus. Each question lists the corpus source(s) a good retrieval should surface; a run scores a retrieval configuration (vector-only vs hybrid, with or without reranking) by whether an expected source appears in the top K results. Matching is deterministic: normalized title equality, plus section and page only when this file records them. Section is the primary evidence-location signal today. Every question also carries a 'page' slot, which the scorer honours (with a one-page tolerance for chunks that straddle a boundary) but which is intentionally left null until the corpus PDFs are ingested and each page number is read off the real document — an invented page number would turn a question into a guaranteed miss. See docs/evaluation/evaluation-strategy.md for the methodology and docs/architecture/rag-architecture.md for the retrieval design.
